method: Targeted assistant inspection of official Vatican English HTML via web retrieval; not a systematic legal update service or a qualified canonical opinion.
source_text_status: Paraphrases and precise locators retained. No original-source byte snapshot or exhaustive Latin collation claimed.
law_currency_limit: The c. 775 §2 amendment was expressly checked. Other amendment histories, authentic interpretations and particular law have not been exhaustively screened.

sources.title: Code of Canon Law: General norms
sources.source_paraphrase: This Code concerns the Latin Church.
sources.interpretive_limit: This pilot does not extend this Code to Eastern Catholic institutions.

sources.title: Code of Canon Law: Ecclesiastical laws
sources.source_paraphrase: Promulgation, authentic interpretation and interpretation in textual context have distinct roles.
sources.interpretive_limit: An assistant summary or advisory opinion is not an authentic interpretation or an authorization.

sources.title: Code of Canon Law: Rights of the faithful
sources.source_paraphrase: The provisions address use of the Catholic name and protection of reputation and privacy.
sources.interpretive_limit: No particular hosting architecture or absolute administrative secrecy is prescribed by c. 220.

sources.title: Code of Canon Law: Catechetical instruction
sources.source_paraphrase: Catechetical responsibilities are distributed among legitimate authority, the bishop, pastors and other participants according to their roles.
sources.interpretive_limit: A technical team is not thereby assigned ecclesial authority. The current c. 775 §2 wording must be read with its amendment.

sources.title: Code of Canon Law: Social communication and publications
sources.source_paraphrase: These canons address supervision, public writings, specified instructional approvals and the scope of approval across editions or translations.
sources.interpretive_limit: Application to a particular generated resource requires attention to content, purpose and distribution. No blanket chatbot ruling is inferred.

sources.title: Code of Canon Law: Catholic education
sources.source_paraphrase: The provisions address formation, Catholic-school identity, religious instruction and oversight.
sources.interpretive_limit: The sources do not specify an automated grading algorithm or software correction protocol.

sources.title: Code of Canon Law: Sacrament of penance
sources.source_paraphrase: The provisions identify the minister and faculty for absolution and protect information from sacramental confession.
sources.interpretive_limit: Ordinary pastoral notes are not automatically sacramental-seal records; no real confession data will be used.

sources.title: Competentias quasdam decernere
sources.source_paraphrase: Article 8 changes c. 775 §2 from approval to confirmation; the letter specifies effect from 15 February 2022.
sources.interpretive_limit: This change concerns the episcopal-conference catechism provision. It does not replace the local-ordinary approval language in c. 827 §1.

sources.title: Antiqua et Nova
sources.source_paraphrase: Human responsibility, control and shared responsibilities for AI use are addressed.
sources.interpretive_limit: Teaching is a normative basis for proposed research questions, not a technical conformance specification.

sources.title: Magnifica Humanitas
sources.source_paraphrase: Accountability, correction and responsible oversight of AI are addressed.
sources.interpretive_limit: These paragraphs do not constitute a software certificate or settle the applicability of a civil statute.
